Here is the script you asked for:

```lua
--! name: Night commits to the morning
--! kinds: commit
--! window: 0
-- Moves commits made between 22:00 and 06:00 one hour later.
function rewrite_commit(c, ctx)
  local h = hour(c.author.time, c.author.offset_minutes)
  if h >= 22 or h < 6 then
    return { author = { time = c.author.time + 3600 } }
  end
end
```

It only touches the author date. Read it before you preview.
